place.name: University of Königsberg
place.description: The University of Königsberg (German: Albertus-Universität Königsberg), commonly known as Albertina, was a university in Königsberg, East Prussia. It was founded in 1544 as the world's second Protestant academy (after the University of Marburg) by Duke Albert of Prussia and received the royal privilege by King Sigismund II Augustus of Poland in 1560.
